headline: Kim Jong Un Visits Dandong via New Cross-Border Bridge to Boost China Trade
summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong Un visited the border city of Dandong after crossing a newly opened bridge, in a symbolic move marking an expansion of economic and trade ties between Pyongyang and Beijing.
why: Sanctions-enforcement shifts and land-border commercial openings between China and North Korea carry critical geopolitical and regional trade ramifications in Northeast Asia.

impacts.name: North Korea
impacts.why: Cross-border bridge infrastructure facilitates increased bilateral goods flow with China.
